title: The two Cartier divisor classes agree and pull back
statement:
Fix the finite coefficients $A=A_{E,n}$ and twists of [def-pur-conventions], [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Let $T$ be a separated finite-type $k$-scheme and let $i:D\hookrightarrow T$ be an effective Cartier divisor [def-pc-divisor-line-bundle]. Apply [lem-pur-divisor-class] with base $B=T$ and the identity $T\to T$ (smooth of relative dimension zero); its general Cartier construction gives $\operatorname{cl}(D)\in H^2_D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A(1))$ [def-pur-support-cohomology]. Then, under the identification $H^2_D(T,A(1))\cong\operatorname{Hom}(i_*A_D,A_T(1)[2])$ of [lem-pur-supported-hom], $\operatorname{cl}(D)$ is the morphism $c_D$ of [lem-amb-cartier-kummer-map]. Consequently, for every morphism $h:T'\to T$ of separated finite-type $k$-schemes such that $D'=T'\times_TD$ is an effective Cartier divisor of $T'$, the supported pullback of [lem-pur-supported-cup-functoriality] satisfies
$$h^*\operatorname{cl}(D)=\operatorname{cl}(D')\quad\text{in }H^2_{D'}(T',A(1)).$$
No smoothness of $T$, $D$, $T'$ or $D'$ is assumed.
